# Long-horizon feature ablation: validation (generated by `scripts/run_long_ablation.py`)

Git commit `b2b4c380e0`. XGBoost, ratio target, long-horizon hyper-parameters, 3 seeds, MAE in MW. Early stopping on validation (mildly optimistic). At 168 h the early-stopped models are very shallow, so that ablation is weak evidence.

## Horizon 72 h

| feature set | MAE (MW) | trees per seed |
|---|---:|---|
| S0_history | 5,308 | 465, 481, 466 |
| S1_calendar | 5,002 | 193, 186, 177 |
| S2_holidays | 5,196 | 110, 128, 138 |
| S3_weatherA | 5,104 | 142, 346, 161 |
| S4_full_A | 4,889 | 272, 419, 439 |
| S5_oracle_B (oracle weather) | 4,454 | 643, 698, 561 |

| step | MAE difference (95% CI) |
|---|---|
| calendar (S0 -> S1) | -306 (-594 to +47) |
| holidays (S1 -> S2) | +194 (-81 to +409) |
| past weather (S2 -> S3) | -92 (-173 to +56) |
| past solar and wind (S3 -> S4) | -215 (-317 to -48) |
| ORACLE weather (S4 -> S5) | -434 (-708 to -194) |
